$comment: Same overlay shape as pathways.zh-CN.json, but only the pathwayNames slice:
Ukrainian Sequence names already ship inside pathway-abilities.json, and a
Ukrainian pathway shares its name with the god at its summit, so there is no
sequences or deityNames block to add.
This lived as a private table inside src/data/pathways.ts until api/meta-proxy.ts
needed the same labels for Ukrainian link previews. The proxy runs outside the
Vite graph and cannot import that module, and a second copy of the table would
have gone stale invisibly, so the data moved here where both can read it.
Pathways with no entry keep their English label; that is what pathwayName()
and the proxy both fall back to.
Registered in the OVERLAYS map in src/data/pathways.ts.
